name: io.github.strangeadvancedmarketing/adam-mcp
description: Exposes Adam Framework vault memory as MCP tools for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible client. Three tools: memory_search (keyword search across vault markdown files), memory_get (retrieve a specific file), memory_list (list all memory files). Works with any markdown vault including Obsidian.

environmentVariables.name: ADAM_VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to your vault directory containing markdown memory files. Defaults to ~/AdamsVault/workspace
